headline: ZenaTech Signs Near $1M in Solar Construction Survey Contracts
summary: ZenaTech's Drone as a Service signed nearly US$1 million in solar construction survey contracts for a U.S. utility, with potential for US$2.5 million in follow-on revenue.
why: New commercial contracts expand revenue pipelines and demonstrate commercial adoption for drone-based enterprise services.

impacts.name: ZenaTech
impacts.why: Securing new commercial contracts provides additional revenue streams.
